category_description: Settings that initialize sampler and filter the data returned by BackPop simulations

settings.name: n_threads
settings.description: Sets the number of cores to use in multiprocessing
settings.options-preface: Used for parallelization of the sampler calculations. Must use a positive integer. If None, no parallelization used.

options.name: integer values
options.description: Number of cores
For example, this sets the number of cores to 2
Default value (not using multiprocessing)

settings.name: n_eff
settings.description: Minimum effective sample size (see nautilus docs for more information)
settings.options-preface: This determines a minimum sample size that needs to be reached for the sampler to converge. However, this does not mean convergence occurs at ``n_eff``.

options.description: For example, this sets the minimum effective sample size to be 8000

settings.name: n_live
settings.description: Number of live points (see nautilus docs for more information)
settings.options-preface: Boundaries are constructed to encompass these live points.

options.description: For example, this sets the number of live points to be 1000

settings.name: verbose
settings.description: Whether to print verbose output from BackPop and sampler.

options.name: True
options.description: Print verbose output from BackPop and sampler progress.

options.name: False
options.description: Do not print verbose output from Backpop and sampler progress.

settings.name: output_folder
settings.description: Path to save output files. If not supplied, output folder created in directory BackPop is run.

options.name: path/to/output_folder
options.description: This specifies the absolute path to save the output files from BackPop.
Default value (not supplying an output path)

settings.name: resume
settings.description: Resumes sampling from previous run (see nautilus docs for more information)

options.name: True
options.description: Resume sampler from previous run.

options.name: False
options.description: Do not resume sampler from previous run. Restart sampler and rewrite files.

settings.name: phase_condition
settings.description: Determines evolutionary state(s) of interest
settings.options-preface: Can use predefined phases or custom phase to target astrophysical events. See COSMIC output docs for more information on evolutionary conventions.

options.name: BH_MS
options.description: For example, this phase selects binaries with a kstar_1 = 14 & kstar_2 = [0,1] or kstar_1 = [0,1] & kstar_2 = 14.
Default does not filter for any condition.

settings.name: use_bcm
settings.description: Saves BCM from Backpop run (see COSMIC BCM docs for more information)

options.name: True
options.description: Saves BCM from BackPop run.

options.name: False
options.description: Does not save BCM from backpop run.

settings.name: bcm_columns
settings.description: Select which columns in the BCM to save
settings.options-preface: Must choose columns that are in COSMIC BCM docs.

options.name: ['tphys', 'kstar_1', 'kstar_2', 'ecc']
options.description: For example, this phase selects binaries with a kstar_1 = 14 & kstar_2 = [0,1] or kstar_1 = [0,1] & kstar_2 = 14.
Default to save all BCM columns if ``use_bcm`` is True.

settings.name: bpp_columns
settings.description: Select which columns in the BPP to save
settings.options-preface: Must choose columns that match the observational constraints given. See COSMIC BPP docs for more information on column names.

options.name: ['mass_1', 'mass_2', 'porb', 'ecc']
options.description: For example, this phase selects binaries with a kstar_1 = 14 & kstar_2 = [0,1] or kstar_1 = [0,1] & kstar_2 = 14.
Default to save all BPP columns.

settings.name: n_bpp_rows
settings.description: Batch size used to label bin_num
settings.options-preface: Should choose a batch size that is large enough to encompass one entire binary evolution.

options.description: For example, this sets the batch size to be 35 lines of the output
Default value is 35 rows

category_description: Observational measurements of an individual binary in solar masses

settings.name: mass_1 mean
settings.description: Observed mass of the primary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the mass to 10 M_sun
Default value

settings.name: mass_1 sigma
settings.description: Uncertainity of the observed mass of the primary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 2 M_sun
Default value

settings.name: mass_2 mean
settings.description: Observed mass of the secondary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the mass to 10 M_sun
Default value

settings.name: mass_2 sigma
settings.description: Uncertainity of the observed mass of the secondary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 2 M_sun
Default value

settings.name: porb mean
settings.description: Observed orbital period in days

options.description: For example, this sets the orbital period to 10 days
Default value

settings.name: porb sigma
settings.description: Uncertainty of the observed orbital period in days

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 2 days
Default value

settings.name: ecc mean
settings.description: Observed eccentricity

options.description: For example, this sets the eccentricity to 0.5
Default value

settings.name: ecc sigma
settings.description: Uncertainity of the observed eccentricity

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 0.01
Default value

category_description: Settings that control the convergence of the simulation run with cosmic-pop

settings.name: convergence_params
settings.description: A list of parameters you would like to verify have converged to a single distribution shape when running cosmic-pop from the command line.

options.name: mass_1
options.description: Primary mass

category_description: Settings that control the single star evolution in the simulation

settings.name: stellar_engine
settings.description: Select which stellar evolution engine to use for single star evolution

options.name: sse
options.description: Use SSE for single star evolution which will apply the fitting formulae from Hurley+2000 for the single star evolution

options.name: metisse
options.description: Use METISSE for single star evolution, must supply path_to_tracks and path_to_he_tracks

settings.name: path_to_tracks
settings.description: Path to the METISSE tracks for single star evolution. Must be supplied if stellar_engine is set to metisse

options.name: path/to/tracks
options.description: This specifies the absolute path to the EEP tracks for single star evolution. Leave the string empty if not using METISSE for single star evolution.
Default value (not using METISSE for single star evolution)

settings.name: path_to_he_tracks
settings.description: Path to the METISSE tracks for helium star evolution. Must be supplied if stellar_engine is set to metisse

options.name: path/to/he_tracks
options.description: This specifies the absolute path to the EEP tracks for helium star evolution. Leave the string empty if not using METISSE for single star evolution.
Default value (not using METISSE for single star evolution)

settings.name: z_accuracy_limit
settings.description: Sets the maximum allowed relative difference between the supplied metallicity and the tracks used by METISSE. If cosmic throws an error due to metallicity, increasing this slightly may help. Must be supplied if stellar_engine is set to metisse

options.name: positive values
options.description: Minimum metallicity
Recommended value

settings.name: metisse_verbose
settings.description: Whether to print verbose output from METISSE when using METISSE for single star evolution.

options.name: True
options.description: Print verbose output from METISSE when using METISSE for single star evolution.

options.name: False
options.description: Do not print verbose output from METISSE when using METISSE for single star evolution.
